muclient.script:
local serialize = require "serialize"
------------ -- VARIABLES ------------ stabletable = {} local sCurrentCharacter = "noname" local is_mounted = false local current_ride_rooms = 0 RoomID = "" local last_recorded_loc_name = "" local pending_loc_name = "" local pending_view_routes = false local last_intended_destination = "" local is_syncing = false
-- GMCP Protocol Constants local IAC = 255 local SB = 250 local SE = 240 local GMCP = 201
function Send_GMCP_Packet (what) assert (what, "Send_GMCP_Packet passed a nil message.") SendPkt (string.char (IAC, SB, GMCP) .. (string.gsub (what, "\255", "\255\255")) .. string.char (IAC, SE)) end
function SendGMCPHandshake() Send_GMCP_Packet('Core.Hello { "client": "MUSHclient", "version": "5.06" }') Send_GMCP_Packet('Core.Supports.Set [ "char.login", "char.info", "char.vitals", "room.info", "room.map", "room.writtenmap" ]') end
function OnPluginConnect() SendGMCPHandshake() end
-------------------------- -- RAW TELNET GMCP HANDLER -------------------------- function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation (type, data) if type == GMCP then if string.find(data, "^room%.info") then local captured_id = string.match(data, '"identifier"%s*:%s*"([^"]+)"') if captured_id then if captured_id ~= RoomID then RoomID = captured_id if last_intended_destination ~= "" then if stabletable.locations and stabletable.locations[last_intended_destination] == RoomID then last_intended_destination = "" end end FinishPendingTasks() if is_mounted then current_ride_rooms = current_ride_rooms + 1 end end end elseif string.find(data, "^char%.login") then local char_name = string.match(data, 'char%.login%s+"([^"]+)"') if char_name and char_name ~= "" then UpdateCharName(char_name) end elseif string.find(data, "^char%.info") then local char_name = string.match(data, '"name"%s*:%s*"([^"]+)"') if char_name and char_name ~= "" then UpdateCharName(char_name) end end end end
function UpdateCharName(forced_name) if not forced_name or forced_name == "" then return end local resolved_name = forced_name:lower()
if resolved_name ~= sCurrentCharacter then local old_char = sCurrentCharacter sCurrentCharacter = resolved_name
if old_char == "noname" and sCurrentCharacter ~= "noname" then if stabletable["noname"] then -- Only migrate noname data if the target character doesn't already have an established table if not stabletable[sCurrentCharacter] then stabletable[sCurrentCharacter] = stabletable["noname"] end stabletable["noname"] = nil end for _, suffix in ipairs({"_MountName", "_MountColour", "_MountType", "_Stabled", "_Horse"}) do if stabletable["noname" .. suffix] then if not stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. suffix] then stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. suffix] = stabletable["noname" .. suffix] end stabletable["noname" .. suffix] = nil end end OnPluginSaveState() end end SetVariable("sCurChar", sCurrentCharacter) checktable() -- Immediately initialize character keys upon resolution end
function checktable() if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return false end stabletable = stabletable or {}
-- Ensure the main character data entry exists as a table if not stabletable[sCurrentCharacter] or type(stabletable[sCurrentCharacter]) ~= "table" then local old_val = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter] stabletable[sCurrentCharacter] = { falloff=0, doorframe=0, wanderoff=0, total_success_rooms=0, total_fail_rooms=0, total_falls=0, total_rides=0, passengers = {} } if type(old_val) == "string" and not stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountName"] then stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountName"] = old_val end DefaultHandlerValues() DefaultChargeValues() else stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].passengers = {} stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].total_success_rooms = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].total_success_rooms or 0 stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].total_fail_rooms = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].total_fail_rooms or 0 stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].total_falls = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].total_falls or 0 stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].total_rides = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].total_rides or 0 stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].falloff = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].falloff or 0 stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].doorframe = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].doorframe or 0 stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].wanderoff = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].wanderoff or 0 end
-- Ensure flat keys have safe defaults if missing stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountName"] = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountName"] or "Unnamed" stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountColour"] = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountColour"] or "unknown" stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountType"] = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountType"] or "horse" stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_Stabled"] = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_Stabled"] or "not stabled."
return true end function OnPluginInstall () stabletable = {} local savedData = GetVariable("stabletable") if savedData and savedData ~= "" then local f, err = loadstring(savedData) if f then local success, result = pcall(f) if not success then Note("Error executing saved mount stats data: " .. tostring(result)) end else Note("Error compiling mount stats: " .. tostring(err)) end end
sCurrentCharacter = "noname"
if IsConnected() then SendGMCPHandshake() end
ColourNote("orange","", string.format("Horse Tracker loaded (v4.0). Awaiting GMCP character verification...")) end
----------------- -- MOUNT ID STUFF ----------------- function ValidateMountOwnership(wildcards) if not wildcards or not wildcards.MountName then return true end local mentioned_name = wildcards.MountName:trim() if mentioned_name == "" then return true end
local registered_name = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountName"] if registered_name and registered_name ~= "Unnamed" then if mentioned_name:lower() ~= registered_name:lower() then return false end end return true end
function ID_Mount (sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end local name = (sName == "MountUnnamed" or not wildcards.MountName or wildcards.MountName == "") and "Unnamed" or wildcards.MountName local desc = wildcards.MountDesc
local words = {} for word in desc:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(words, word) end
if #words > 0 then local mountType = table.remove(words) local mountColour = table.concat(words, " ")
stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountName"] = tostring(name) stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountColour"] = tostring(mountColour) stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountType"] = mountType
EnableTrigger("MountName", false) EnableTrigger("MountUnnamed", false)
if name == "Unnamed" then ColourNote("orange", "", string.format("Mount Registered: Unnamed %s (%s) â [Type 'name mount as <name>']", mountType, mountColour)) else ColourNote("orange", "", string.format("Mount Registered: %s the %s %s", name, mountColour, mountType)) end OnPluginSaveState() end end
function ID_UnnamedMount (sName, sLine, wildcards) ID_Mount(sName, sLine, wildcards) end
function MountNameFinder () if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then ColourNote("orange", "", "[Horse Tracker] Character identity not yet verified by GMCP.") return end EnableTrigger("MountName", true) EnableTrigger("MountUnnamed", true) SendNoEcho("glance my mount") end
function NameMyMount (sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end if wildcards.MountName and wildcards.MountName ~= "" then stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountName"] = wildcards.MountName:trim() ColourNote("green", "", "[Horse Tracker] Your mount has been named: " .. stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountName"]) OnPluginSaveState() end end
function DenameMyMount (sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end stabletable[sCurrentCharacter .. "_MountName"] = "Unnamed" ColourNote("orange", "", "[Horse Tracker] Your mount is now anonymous.") OnPluginSaveState() end
-------------------------------- -- FOOLS GUILD POSITION HANDLERS -------------------------------- function FoolMountPosition(sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end
if not ValidateMountOwnership(wildcards) then return end
local passenger = wildcards.Passenger and wildcards.Passenger:trim() if not passenger or passenger == "" then return end if passenger:lower() == "you" then return end
local pos = tonumber(sName:match("Pos(%d+)")) if not pos then return end
local charData = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter] charData.passengers = charData.passengers or {}
for existingPos, name in pairs(charData.passengers) do if name:lower() == passenger:lower() then charData.passengers[existingPos] = nil end end
charData.passengers[pos] = passenger ColourNote("green", "", string.format("[Horse Tracker] (Fool Mount) %s mounted at Position %d.", passenger, pos)) end
function FoolDismountPosition(sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end
if not ValidateMountOwnership(wildcards) then return end
local passenger = wildcards.Passenger and wildcards.Passenger:trim() if not passenger or passenger == "" then return end
if passenger:lower() == "you" then stabletable[sCurrentCharacter].passengers = {} ColourNote("orange", "", "[Horse Tracker] You have dismounted. Passenger stack cleared.") return end
local charData = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter] charData.passengers = charData.passengers or {}
local was_passenger = false for pos, name in pairs(charData.passengers) do if name:lower() == passenger:lower() then charData.passengers[pos] = nil was_passenger = true break end end
if was_passenger then ColourNote("orange", "", string.format("[Horse Tracker] (Fool Fall/Dismount) %s fell off your horse.", passenger)) elseif sLine:find("strike your heads hard on the doorframe") then charData.passengers = {} ColourNote("red", "", "[Horse Tracker] Doorframe crash! All Fool passengers dislodged.") end end
function ListFoolPassengers() if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end local charData = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter] local passengers = charData.passengers or {}
local riderName = charData.rider or sCurrentCharacter if riderName == sCurrentCharacter and sCurrentCharacter ~= "noname" then riderName = sCurrentCharacter:gsub("^%l", string.upper) end
ColourNote("orange", "", "--- HORSE PASSENGERS ---") ColourNote("white", "", "1 - " .. riderName .. " (Rider)")
for i = 2, 11 do if passengers[i] then ColourNote("white", "", i .. " - " .. passengers[i]) end end
ColourNote("orange", "", "----------------------------------") end
------------------------ -- LOCATION ROUTE ENGINE ------------------------ function CaptureIntentName (sName, sLine, wildcards) last_recorded_loc_name = wildcards.loc_name Send(sLine) end
function FinishPendingTasks() if RoomID ~= "" then if pending_loc_name ~= "" then stabletable.locations = stabletable.locations or {} stabletable.locations[pending_loc_name] = RoomID ColourNote("green", "", "[Horse Tracker] Auto-Saved: '" .. pending_loc_name .. "' is now mapped.") pending_loc_name = "" OnPluginSaveState() end
if pending_view_routes then pending_view_routes = false Note("") ListHorseRoutes() end end end
function EnsureRoomID(target_name) if RoomID == "" or RoomID == nil then if target_name then pending_loc_name = target_name else pending_view_routes = true end SendNoEcho("glance") ColourNote("orange", "", "[Horse Tracker] RoomID missing. Nudging game... Task will complete automatically.") return false end return true end
function LearnLocation (sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end if last_recorded_loc_name == "" then return end if EnsureRoomID(last_recorded_loc_name) then stabletable.locations = stabletable.locations or {} stabletable.locations[last_recorded_loc_name] = RoomID ColourNote("green", "", "[Horse Tracker] Location Mapped: " .. last_recorded_loc_name) OnPluginSaveState() last_recorded_loc_name = "" end end
function RecordRoute (sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end stabletable.routes = stabletable.routes or {} local loc1, loc2 = wildcards.loc1, wildcards.loc2 stabletable.routes[loc1] = stabletable.routes[loc1] or {} stabletable.routes[loc2] = stabletable.routes[loc2] or {} stabletable.routes[loc1][loc2] = true stabletable.routes[loc2][loc1] = true ColourNote("green", "", "[Horse Tracker] Route Linked: " .. loc1 .. " <-> " .. loc2) last_recorded_loc_name = "" OnPluginSaveState() end
function ManualAddLocation (sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end local name = wildcards.loc_name if EnsureRoomID(name) then stabletable.locations = stabletable.locations or {} stabletable.locations[name] = RoomID ColourNote("green", "", "[Horse Tracker] Manually added '" .. name) OnPluginSaveState() end end
function ManualAddRoute (sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end local loc1, loc2 = wildcards.loc1:lower(), wildcards.loc2:lower() if not stabletable.locations[loc1] or not stabletable.locations[loc2] then ColourNote("orange", "", "[Horse Tracker] Error: Unknown locations. Use 'horse map loc' first.") return end stabletable.routes = stabletable.routes or {} stabletable.routes[loc1] = stabletable.routes[loc1] or {} stabletable.routes[loc2] = stabletable.routes[loc2] or {} stabletable.routes[loc1][loc2] = true stabletable.routes[loc2][loc1] = true ColourNote("green", "", "[Horse Tracker] Manually linked: " .. loc1 .. " <-> " .. loc2) OnPluginSaveState() end
function RenameLocation (sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end local old = wildcards.old_name:trim() local new = wildcards.new_name:trim() local existingID = stabletable.locations[old]
if not existingID then for k, v in pairs(stabletable.locations) do if k:lower() == old:lower() then old = k existingID = v break end end end
local id_to_use = existingID or "pending" if RoomID and RoomID ~= "" then id_to_use = RoomID end
stabletable.locations[new] = id_to_use if old ~= new then stabletable.locations[old] = nil end
if stabletable.routes then if stabletable.routes[old] then stabletable.routes[new] = stabletable.routes[old] stabletable.routes[old] = nil end for startNode, connections in pairs(stabletable.routes) do if connections[old] then connections[new] = true connections[old] = nil end end end OnPluginSaveState() end
function ToggleFavorite(sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end local loc = wildcards.loc:lower():trim() stabletable.favs = stabletable.favs or {} if stabletable.favs[loc] then stabletable.favs[loc] = nil ColourNote("orange", "", "[Horse Tracker] Removed '" .. loc .. "' from favorites.") else stabletable.favs[loc] = true ColourNote("green", "", "[Horse Tracker] Added '" .. loc .. "' to favorites.") end OnPluginSaveState() end
function ListHorseRoutes(sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end local show_all = true if wildcards.fav and wildcards.fav:trim() == "fav" then show_all = false end if not EnsureRoomID() then return end
local currentLoc = nil for name, id in pairs(stabletable.locations or {}) do if id == RoomID then currentLoc = name; break end end
if not currentLoc then ColourNote("orange", "", "[Horse Tracker] No known location name for this Room ID.") return end
local reachableDestinations = GetAllReachable(currentLoc) if #reachableDestinations > 0 then local title = show_all and "All Available Routes" or "Favorite Routes" ColourNote("green", "", title .. " from " .. currentLoc .. ":") table.sort(reachableDestinations) local found_any = false
for _, destination in ipairs(reachableDestinations) do local is_fav = stabletable.favs and stabletable.favs[destination:lower()] or false if show_all or is_fav then found_any = true local my_label = tostring(destination) local my_command = "ride to " .. my_label .. " on my mount" local my_color = is_fav and "yellow" or "cyan" Tell(" [") Hyperlink(my_command, my_label, "Ride to " .. my_label, my_color, "black", false) Tell("]") Note("") end end if not found_any and not show_all then Note(" (No favorites defined for this route.)") end else ColourNote("orange", "", "[Horse Tracker] No routes found from " .. currentLoc) end end
function HorseMapDebug() if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end ColourNote("green", "", "--- MOUNT MAP DEBUG ---") for name, id in pairs(stabletable.locations or {}) do print(" " .. name) end end
function ClearMapAll(name, line, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end local confirmation = string.trim(wildcards[1]):lower() if confirmation == "confirm" then stabletable.locations = {} stabletable.routes = {} ColourNote("white", "red", "[Horse Tracker] ALL locations and routes wiped.") OnPluginSaveState() else ColourNote("orange", "", "[Horse Tracker] Type: horse map clear all confirm") end end
local pending_forget_name = "" function CaptureForgetIntent (sName, sLine, wildcards) pending_forget_name = wildcards.loc Send(sLine) end
function ForgetLocation (sName, sLine, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end local target = pending_forget_name if target == "" then return end for k, v in pairs(stabletable.locations) do if k:lower() == target:lower() then stabletable.locations[k] = nil if stabletable.routes then stabletable.routes[k] = nil for _, connections in pairs(stabletable.routes) do connections[k] = nil end end ColourNote("orange", "", "[Horse Tracker] Forgotten: " .. k) OnPluginSaveState() break end end pending_forget_name = "" end
function HorseMapSummary() if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end local total_locs, mapped_locs = 0, 0 for _, id in pairs(stabletable.locations or {}) do total_locs = total_locs + 1 if id ~= "pending" then mapped_locs = mapped_locs + 1 end end ColourNote("orange", "", string.format("--- MAPPED LOCATIONS: %d total (%d calibrated) ---", total_locs, mapped_locs)) end
function StartHorseSync() if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end is_syncing = true EnableTrigger("HorseSyncLine", true) EnableTrigger("HorseSyncSingle", true) EnableTrigger("HorseSyncEnd", true) end
function StopHorseSync() EnableTrigger("HorseSyncLine", false) EnableTrigger("HorseSyncSingle", false) EnableTrigger("HorseSyncEnd", false) if is_syncing then is_syncing = false; OnPluginSaveState() end end
function ProcessSyncSingle(name, line, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end local source = wildcards.source:lower():trim() stabletable.locations = stabletable.locations or {} if not stabletable.locations[source] then stabletable.locations[source] = "pending" end end
function ProcessSyncLine(name, line, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end local source = wildcards.source:lower():trim() local connectionsRaw = wildcards.dest:lower() -- <--- Changed from 'dests' to 'dest' stabletable.routes = stabletable.routes or {} stabletable.locations = stabletable.locations or {} if not stabletable.locations[source] then stabletable.locations[source] = "pending" end connectionsRaw = connectionsRaw:gsub("%s+and%s+", ", ") for target in connectionsRaw:gmatch("[^,]+") do target = target:trim() if not stabletable.locations[target] then stabletable.locations[target] = "pending" end stabletable.routes[source] = stabletable.routes[source] or {} stabletable.routes[target] = stabletable.routes[target] or {} stabletable.routes[source][target] = true stabletable.routes[target][source] = true end end
function ConfirmArrival() if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if last_intended_destination == "" then return end if RoomID == "" then SendNoEcho("glance"); return end stabletable.locations[last_intended_destination] = RoomID ColourNote("green", "", "[Horse Tracker] Verified destination: " .. last_intended_destination) last_intended_destination = "" OnPluginSaveState() end
function ListUnmappedLocations() if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end local unmapped = {} for name, val in pairs(stabletable.locations or {}) do if val == "pending" then table.insert(unmapped, name) end end ColourNote("orange", "", "Pending Calibration: " .. (#unmapped > 0 and table.concat(unmapped, ", ") or "None")) end
function GetAllReachable(startNode) local reachable, visited, queue = {}, {}, {startNode} visited[startNode] = true local i = 1 while i <= #queue do local current = queue[i]; i = i + 1 for neighbour, _ in pairs(stabletable.routes and stabletable.routes[current] or {}) do if not visited[neighbour] then visited[neighbour] = true table.insert(queue, neighbour) table.insert(reachable, neighbour) end end end return reachable end
function string.trim(s) return s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
---------------- -- CORE HANDLERS ---------------- function MountHandler(sName, sline, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end
if not ValidateMountOwnership(wildcards) then return end
local charData = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter]
local event_name = sName if sName == "dismount_hop" then event_name = "dismount" elseif sName == "mountsuccess_run" then event_name = "mountsuccess" end
charData[event_name] = (charData[event_name] or 0) + 1
if event_name == "mountsuccess" then is_mounted = true current_ride_rooms = 0 elseif event_name == "dismount" then if is_mounted then charData.total_success_rooms = charData.total_success_rooms + current_ride_rooms charData.total_rides = charData.total_rides + 1 end is_mounted = false current_ride_rooms = 0 charData.passengers = {} elseif (event_name == "falloff" or event_name == "tipfail" or event_name == "doorframe") and is_mounted then charData.total_fail_rooms = charData.total_fail_rooms + current_ride_rooms charData.total_falls = charData.total_falls + 1 is_mounted = false current_ride_rooms = 0 charData.passengers = {} end
local action = event_name:gsub("success", ""):gsub("fail", "") local s = charData[action .. "success"] or 0 local f = charData[action .. "fail"] or 0 if (s + f) > 0 then charData[action .. "ratio"] = math.floor(((s / (s + f)) * 100) + 0.5) .. "%" end
if event_name == "ridesuccess" then is_mounted = true current_ride_rooms = 0 if wildcards.dest then last_intended_destination = wildcards.dest:lower():trim() end end OnPluginSaveState() end
function MountChargeHandler(sName, sline, wildcards) if sCurrentCharacter == "noname" then return end if not checktable() then return end
if not ValidateMountOwnership(wildcards) then return end
local gait = wildcards[3]:lower() local charData = stabletable[sCurrentCharacter] local statKey = sName .. gait charData[statKey] = (charData[statKey] or 0) + 1 local s = charData["chargesuccess" .. gait] or 0 local f = charData["chargefail" .. gait] or 0 if (s + f) > 0 then charData["charge" .. gait .. "ratio"] = math.floor(((s / (s + f)) * 100) + 0.5) .. "%" end OnPluginSaveState() end

local s_rooms = data.total_success_rooms or 0 local f_rooms = data.total_fail_rooms or 0 local active_rooms = (is_mounted and target == sCurrentCharacter) and current_ride_rooms or 0 local falls = data.total_falls or 0 local rides = data.total_rides or 0 local avg_fail = falls > 0 and math.floor(f_rooms / falls) or 0 local success_rate = (rides + falls) > 0 and math.floor((rides / (rides + falls)) * 100) or 0

ColourNote("white","", "--------------------------------------------------") ColourNote("green","", "Charge/Storm Stats:")
local gaits = {"walk", "trot", "canter", "gallop"} for _, g in ipairs(gaits) do local s = data["chargesuccess"..g] or 0 local f = data["chargefail"..g] or 0 local pct = data["charge"..g.."ratio"] or "-" local displayGait = g:gsub("^%l", string.upper) ColourNote("orange", "", string.format(" %-15s Success: %-4d Fail: %-4d (%s)", displayGait .. ":", s, f, pct)) end ColourNote("white","", "--------------------------------------------------") OnPluginSaveState() end
